_comment: Skill selection: the model sees only the five frontmatter blocks (name, description, location) and one user ask, and answers with one skill name or none. Every expectation must be derivable from the descriptions alone; a case that needs the skill bodies to answer belongs in lane B. The oracle for each case is its expect value.
